title: Branch structure and nonextensive thermodynamics of Kalb-Ramond-ModMax black holes: observational signatures
summary: Motivated by the low-energy effective action of heterotic string theory, where the Kalb-Ramond (KR) two-form and nonlinear gauge corrections arise simultaneously, we investigate a static, spherically symmetric black hole (BH) in Einstein gravity coupled to a KR field and ModMax nonlinear electrodynamics (NED). The solution depends, beyond mass and charge, on the Lorentz-symmetry-breaking (LSB) parameter $\ell$, the ModMax deformation parameter $γ$, and a discrete branch selector $ζ=\pm1$.
